focus_areas: Feather texture realism and edge definition
Anatomical correctness of the spur and feet
Grounding of feet on the dirt surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the neck hackles and the body plumage; AI often blurs these distinct feather types. Verify that the spur on the leg is a distinct, hard structure and not a soft tissue anomaly. Ensure the shadow cast by the rooster aligns physically with the light source implied by the highlights on the feathers. Use the geometric depth map to confirm the feet are firmly planted on the ground plane without sinking or floating.
image_description: A side-profile view of an adult male rooster (cock) standing on a dirt ground. The bird features vibrant plumage with golden-orange hackle feathers, a black breast and body, and long, curved black tail feathers. It has a prominent red comb and wattles, yellow legs with visible scales, and is casting a shadow to its left.
